title: Merchandise Purchases — Bank-Fee Allowance on a Second Capture by Debit or Bank Card
content:
**Allowance.** A second capture of a Merchandise Purchases unit's payment made by debit card, which drew on the customer's bank account, and at least the bank-fee days of 3 days old on the request date earns the debit bank-fee allowance of $35.00; one made by bank credit card and at least 3 days old earns the credit-card bank-fee allowance of $15.00. A second capture made by any other tender or less than 3 days old on the request date, and a unit with no second capture, are outside this rule.

A capture is at least 3 days old when the request date falls 3 or more calendar days after the capture date.

## Both sides of the age threshold (hypothetical capture on 5 May)

| Tender of the second capture | Request date | Days after capture | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| debit | 8 May | 3 | $35.00 |
| debit | 7 May | 2 | outside this rule |
| bank card | 8 May | 3 | $15.00 |
| bank card | 7 May | 2 | outside this rule |
| cash | 20 May | 15 | outside this rule |
| debit, captured once only (no second capture) | 20 May | 15 | outside this rule |
